name: Accessible Form Validation
description: Replaces the browser's native HTML5 validation popups with inline, themeable, screen-reader-friendly error messages.
project_description:
Improves accessibility by converting native browser form validation messages into inline messages compatible with screen readers and theming.

The module attaches a small JS behaviour that adds `novalidate` to forms with required fields, then re-implements client-side validation through the Constraint Validation API. On blur/input and on submit it marks each failing field with `aria-invalid="true"`, injects the browser's validationMessage into an inline error container inside the field's `.form-item`, toggles error/valid CSS classes, and moves focus to the first invalid field on a blocked submit. Enable independently for the default (front-end) theme and the admin theme, and optionally override the CSS class used for the error-message container on the default theme. No dependencies beyond Drupal core.
